KEYS REQUIRED BEFORE PROCEEDING
You should have already collected your keys from 23 Lonsdale Street, Braddon before going to the property. If you don't have your keys yet, tap here for key collection instructions or call us on 0493 173 122.

Check-In Instructions

Choose your check-in route below.

Step 1
Your Keys
Your keyring has two items — a remote and a standard door key. The remote acts as your swipe card for every reader you see and the buttons open the car park garage. The door key is for the front door of the apartment.
Step 2
Enter the Building
Head to 1 Boolee Street, Reid. Enter through the Metropol 3 lobby — look for the "METROPOL 3" sign above the glass doors.
Step 3
Take the Lift to Level 7
Take the lift to Level 7. Scan your key fob on the reader and press button 7.
Step 4
Find Apartment 709
Turn right out of the elevator and right again — Apartment 709 is located on the right hand side. Use your door key to enter. Enjoy your stay!
Step 1
Your Keys
Your keyring has two items — a remote and a standard door key. The remote acts as your swipe card for every reader you see and the buttons open the car park garage. The door key is for the front door of the apartment.
Step 2
Head to 81 Cooyong Street
After collecting your keys, go to 81 Cooyong Street and take a left at the Akuna Street intersection into the carpark.
Step 3
Continue Down the Ramp
Continue down the ramp in the carpark.
Step 4
Turn Right Between the Pillars
Follow the ramp down and turn right in between the pillars to go down a level.
Step 5
Turn Right Again
Turn right again when you are down the ramp.
Step 6
Pass the Black Garage Door
Continue straight past the black garage door on the right, then turn right toward the next ramp.
Step 7
Up the Ramp, Turn Left
Once you reach the end you will see an up ramp — go up the ramp and turn left at the black garage door.
Step 8
Open the Garage Door
Proceed to the black garage door shown and press the buttons on your Urmet remote to open it.
Step 9
Follow Road to the End, Turn Left
After the gate, follow the road straight all the way to the end and turn left.
Step 10
Locate Space 709/1
Look for car space 709/1 — it is straight ahead and adjacent to the double elevators.
Step 11
Park in Space 709/1
Park in space 709/1.
Step 12
Take the B1 Lifts
You are on Level B1. Take the lifts adjacent to your car space — they are marked B1.
Step 13
Scan Fob & Press Level 7
Inside the lift, scan your key fob on the reader then press Level 7.
Step 14
Find Apartment 709
Turn right out of the elevator and right again — Apartment 709 is located on the right hand side. Use your door key to enter. Enjoy your stay!
